messages:
alex_support: Heads-up: Riverview Clinic is blocked exporting audit logs for 2025-11-02 to 2025-11-04. They're hitting 403 from /api/v1/audit/export. BAA review with their security lead tomorrow AM. Also asked for KMS key rotation timeline and HSM attestations. Need infra + compliance help.

maria_compliance: Can you confirm which environment and S3 bucket? Also we should send them BAA addendum + audit export SLA doc. I'll prep. @samir_infra can you look at the 403?

samir_infra: On it. 403 usually means KMS decrypt/generate permissions missing or the export role isn't allowed on the key. Can you paste the raw error block and request id?

alex_support: Error block:
{
  "error": "Forbidden",
  "code": 403,
  "request_id": "req_9f3b2a"
}
They said env=prod-us-east-1, bucket=riverview-logs-prod, role=riverview-exporter-role.

samir_infra: Try reproducing with curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?start=2025-11-02&end=2025-11-04&bucket=riverview-logs-prod"
```
Locally I get 403 too. Checking key policy now.

audit-bot: KMS key kms-rv-prod-1: last rotation 2025-10-28; key policy missing principal arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/riverview-exporter-role

samir_infra: Confirmed. Key policy doesn't allow the export role to use Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. Will add a limited statement for the role. Will not change admin principals.

maria_compliance: Once fixed, we need a short confirmation note for the customer listing: 1) what changed, 2) timestamp, 3) who approved. I'll draft the addendum snippet for BAA.

ryan_oncall: Also saw a spike in latency on export route earlier (p95 4.2s), but not related to 403. FYI in case they mention slowness.

samir_infra: Patch applied: added policy statement to kms-rv-prod-1 for principal arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/riverview-exporter-role allowing kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey for resources * restricted to encryption context 'export:bucket=riverview-logs-prod'. Retrying export now.

alex_support: Customer just tried again — says export now succeeds. Could you paste the confirmation request id so I can include it?

samir_infra: Export returned 200, request_id=req_9f3b2a (same id, retried). Files available in s3://riverview-logs-prod/exports/2025-11-02_2025-11-04.tar.gz
I also uploaded a short repro + fix to #eng-infra/knowledge: 'kms-export-role-fix-2025-11'

maria_compliance: Perfect. I'll send them an email with the remediation summary and the BAA addendum doc. Addendum will note key rotation schedule and HSM attestation URL.

alex_support: I'll tell Riverview: export succeeded, attach export path, confirm BAA doc coming, and provide timeline for HSM attestation (link). Thanks all. Closing after they ack.

alex_support: Customer ACK via email: 'we received the export and file checksums match. thank you.' Closing thread.
